items.title: US troops fully withdraw from Baghdad base after two decades

items.title: 'Factory of targets' and 'collateral damage': Israeli soldiers describe Gaza methods
items.description: Israeli officers spoke to Le Monde, in collaboration with the NGO Breaking The Silence, about the military's rules of engagement in Gaza, the acknowledged number of civilian casualties caused by its operations, and the extensive use of artificial intelligence.

items.title: Ethiopia: No regard for civilians as fighting in Ethiopia's Tigray region continues
items.description: Fighting has returned to northern Ethiopia, shattering a fragile peace in the region. DW spoke to civilians caught in the crossfire amid communication blackouts, as rebel and federal forces keep battling for territory.

items.title: As the U.S. signals a smaller Middle East footprint, Turkey is ready to step in
items.description: Turkey's bid for regional influence comes as the Middle East has been hit by profound shocks that started with the Hamas-led 2023 attack on Israel and continue with the seven-month-old war on Iran.

items.description: A new wave of deadly Russian attacks on Ukrainian cities is fueling bipartisan calls in Washington for US President Donald Trump to use sweeping new sanctions powers against Moscow, with lawmakers arguing that greater economic pressure could strengthen efforts to end the war.

items.title: What Matters More to Putin? Russian Refineries or Striking Ukraine?
items.description: Kyiv Post Senior Defense Correspondent Stefan Korshak joins TVP World to discuss whether an energy ceasefire could pave the way for broader negotiations, how Ukrainian strikes are affecting Russia’s war economy, and why the Kremlin continues to favor military pressure over compromise.
